dedupe_keys.name: a high resolution gridded dataset for china s monthly sectoral water use

description: A High-Resolution Gridded Dataset for China’s Monthly Sectoral Water Use is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Yuqian Zhang et al. High-quality water use datasets are used to advance water resources research in changing environment. However, existing Chinese water use data, typically aggregated by administrative boundaries or watersheds, lack sufficient spatial and temporal resolution. This limitation hinders detailed analysis of human water use patterns and spatiotemporal variations. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2025. Formats: NetCDF. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 3582419919 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
